metadata.scenario: A prospect contacts the clinic to learn more about their psychological counseling services. They want to understand the therapist's qualifications and the types of therapy offered. Category: New Inquiry. Customer type: prospect.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret. How can I assist you today? Hi Margaret, this is Eleanor Watson. I'm actually looking for more information about your psychological counseling services. I’m glad you reached out, Eleanor. Just to clarify, we don’t offer psychological counseling at CareFirst. Oh, I see. I thought I saw that listed somewhere. What types of services do you provide then? We specialize in skilled nursing care, physical therapy, and personal care assistance, among others. That makes sense. I have been receiving physical therapy and skilled nursing care for my recovery. Yes, you have been with us for 14 months now, if I recall correctly. How is your recovery going? It’s been a journey, but I’m improving, thanks to your team. That’s great to hear, Eleanor! Dr. Rodriguez has been really dedicated to your post-stroke rehabilitation. Yes, he has been wonderful. Can you tell me more about the types of therapy you offer? Certainly! We provide physical therapy for mobility, strength, and balance improvement. And what about the skilled nursing care? Our skilled nursing care includes medication management, wound care, and health monitoring. That sounds helpful. What are the pricing details for those services? Skilled nursing care ranges from $95 to $125 for a 1-2 hour visit, while physical therapy is $110 to $140 for 45-60 minutes. Thanks for the information! I appreciate it. Are there any follow-up appointments I should be aware of? Your last visit was three days ago, and we can schedule your next session as needed. That would be great. I’d like to book my next physical therapy appointment for next week. Absolutely! We can look at available slots between 10 AM and 2 PM, as per your preference. Yes, that works for me. Let me check our schedule for you. One moment, please. Sure, take your time. It looks like we have openings on Tuesday and Thursday next week during your preferred hours. I’ll take Tuesday, please. Great choice! I’ll confirm that for you. Thank you, Margaret. You're welcome, Eleanor! Is there anything else I can assist you with today? No, that’s all for now. Thanks again! Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health. Have a wonderful day! You too, bye! Goodbye!
